title: Your Dog Doesn't Scoop Water (Slow Motion)
description:
Your dog doesn't scoop water with its tongue. It does something much messier 🐕

It curls the tongue backwards, slaps the surface and yanks it up so fast that a column of water follows, then bites the top off. Researchers filmed 19 dogs to work it out. The mess is leftover water flung out of the curled tongue. Cats use the same trick, just gently.

Whose drinking is louder in your house, the dog or the cat? 👇

Source: Gart, Socha, Vlachos & Jung, PNAS (2015), "Dogs lap using acceleration-driven open pumping".
Animated with real physics by Counterphysical. AI voice.
